_comment: Families to load. 'files' are tried in order and the first that exists is loaded. 'name' may be a list: the first name that is loaded counts as the family. Relative paths resolve against the folder this file is in. A Revit version newer than the shipped family loads (and upgrades) the newest shipped one. 'placeholder_if_missing': if no file can be loaded (an older Revit), build a Generic Model with a small square marker under the first name instead.
